_comment: TDD M4 reasoning slice 1: a known-EMPTY effort enum is not unknown-neutral; any requested level is outside the known values and stays a diagnosed loss. Strict 400 pre-IO. GREEN on baseline by coincidence (old loss and new loss agree); guards post-impl against collapsing empty into neutral.
name: m4_reasoning_chat_responses_empty_enum_mismatch_strict
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-chat".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = []
